assertions.when: Both pasteboard changes are processed; then `log show --info --debug` for the subsystem, all signposts, the Notices list and a fresh Copy Diagnostics report are searched
assertions.then: 0 occurrences of 'markuti1' and 0 occurrences of the dyn. identifier in every source; where a type field is logged for those events it reads '<private>' for the non-system-declared types and 'public.utf8-plain-text' in clear text for the system-declared one

assertions.given: A copy of the app sources
assertions.when: Two mutations are built separately: (1) a log context's source-app bundle identifier is given an arbitrary String (e.g. the clip's text); (2) a log context's pasteboard type identifier is given an arbitrary String
assertions.then: Each mutated build fails to compile (2 of 2 red) because the log context accepts only a validated bundle identifier and a classified type identifier; reverting each mutation builds green

assertions.given: Flotsam running with subsystem logging captured; Library holds files, folders, images, a bundle and tags
assertions.when: Every organize path is driven: multi-select of 2+ files, folders and images, every context-menu and menu-bar action on them, Ungroup, tag rename to an 81-character name and to an empty name, note and text edits
assertions.then: `log show` for the subsystem contains 0 entries for ORG-VAL-004 and 0 for ORG-VAL-005; no HUD, Notice or inline validation text shows either code or the retired texts 'Select at least two files, folders or images to group.' or 'Names must be 1 to 80 characters.'

assertions.given: The built Release Flotsam.app
assertions.when: Its executable and compiled string catalogue are searched for the raw strings and texts
assertions.then: 0 occurrences of 'ORG-VAL-004', 'ORG-VAL-005', 'error.ORG-VAL-004', 'error.ORG-VAL-005', 'Select at least two files, folders or images to group.' and 'Names must be 1 to 80 characters.' (retired codes cannot be raised or shown)

assertions.given: A diagnostics report R1 was copied with text-item count t and Accessibility granted
assertions.when: One new unique text is copied (count +1), Accessibility is revoked for Flotsam, then Copy Diagnostics is clicked again producing R2
assertions.then: R2's text-item count is exactly t+1 and every other kind's count is unchanged from R1; R2 shows Accessibility as not granted; R2 is built from current state, not a cached R1

assertions.given: The production clock (SystemClock)
assertions.when: sleep(for: 50 ms) is awaited in a live task, and separately in a task cancelled before or during the sleep
assertions.then: The live sleep returns after at least 50 ms of real elapsed time; the cancelled sleep returns early (well under the requested duration) without throwing, and the caller observes Task.isCancelled == true
assertions.amended: 2026-11-17 added by Friday after FRD-000 8V re-run: SystemClock.sleep had no runtime coverage (survivors N8b/N8c/N8d)
